description: Source code for a configuration wizard in the OpenERP (Odoo) system, defining a class for installing modules with various options.

classes.name: profile_service_config_install_modules_wizard
classes.description: A wizard class for configuring and installing modules with specific features in OpenERP.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the wizard and returns to a default form view.

methods.name: action_install
methods.description: Reads selected options, searches and installs corresponding modules, then restarts the pool and returns to the wizard form.
